lead: Jacob Zuma returns to the campaign trail at a KwaMashu rally today as parties wrap up campaigning before special voting starts tomorrow, while the Proteas celebrate a 2-1 Test series win over Australia.

items.title: Zuma to headline MK rally in KwaMashu after hospital stay
items.summary: The MK Party leader is due at Princess Magogo Stadium today for his first campaign rally since an 11-day hospital stay in October, after a short YouTube address on Friday urging supporters to give the party a decisive mandate.

items.title: Special voting runs Monday and Tuesday ahead of Wednesday's poll
items.summary: The IEC expects about 2.6 million special votes on 2 and 3 November, including more than 600,000 home visits, mostly to voters over 60. Some 29 million people are registered for the 4 November municipal elections.

items.title: DA and EFF hold final rallies; ANC wraps up in Mdantsane
items.summary: The DA closed its campaign in Mamelodi and the EFF in Soweto on Saturday. The ANC's Siyanqoba rally with Ramaphosa is set for Mdantsane today, while the IFP holds its final rally in Ulundi.

items.title: Police seek final order restricting March and March in Durban
items.summary: An interim Durban High Court interdict bars the movement from marches and encampments in parts of the CBD and near the refugee reception centre. Friday's hearing was briefly adjourned so police could add video evidence.

items.title: Johannesburg residents protest as water supply is throttled
items.summary: Residents in several suburbs protested over outages and planned throttling. Johannesburg Water says its system is severely constrained and is weighing tougher restrictions, while Rand Water says the city has exceeded its consumption target every month this year.

items.title: Taxi violence raises fears for Cape Town voters
items.summary: Ongoing taxi conflict in Cape Town has sparked concern that thousands of residents who depend on public transport may struggle to reach polling stations on Wednesday.

items.title: Ramaphosa-backed talks aim to break universal health care deadlock
items.summary: A confidential initiative supported by the president is trying to find common ground on universal health care and fix service failures, as medico-legal claims against provincial health departments top R32bn.

items.title: Iran says Hormuz could reopen within two days if US meets terms
items.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi says talks with Qatari mediators are under way on a two-day plan to reopen the strait, and an Iranian security official called a letter from US Vice President Vance a positive shift in tone.

items.title: US midterms on Tuesday as early voting passes 43 million
items.summary: An AP analysis counts more than 43 million early votes, about 10 million ahead of 2022. Analysts see the House likely flipping to Democrats, with the Senate much less certain.

items.title: DR Congo Ebola deaths pass 5,000
items.summary: The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak has infected more than 10,000 people across eight provinces since May, with no approved vaccine or treatment. Kenya, Uganda and Nigeria have also reported cases.

items.title: US approves $2.1bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
items.summary: The State Department cleared a possible sale of 500 PAC-3 interceptors, though deliveries are not expected until the 2030s. Partners including Canada, Germany and Norway will help fund the purchase.

items.title: UN ends its political mission in Somalia after three decades
items.summary: The UN transitional mission ceased operations on Saturday at Mogadishu's request, handing its work to Somali institutions and other UN bodies amid an unresolved dispute over the president's term.

items.title: AGOA eligibility ruling expected on Monday
items.summary: Washington's decision on South Africa's duty-free access is due 2 November. Trade Minister Tau says offers on poultry and pork access were made in September and that South Africa would get 60 days to respond to any concerns.

items.title: JSE Top 40 drops 2.4% as Wall Street tumbles
items.summary: The Top 40 closed the week at about 99,400 with the rand near R16.71/$. In New York the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.9% on Friday as Intel and Reddit each lost about 29%.

items.title: Brent jumps 13.6% in October; OPEC+ meets today
items.summary: Brent's January contract settled at $113.43 on Friday after a fourth straight monthly gain. Seven core OPEC+ members meet online today and were expected to keep December output targets unchanged.

items.title: November fuel price change due Wednesday, official figures pending
items.summary: New prices take effect on 4 November but had not been published by the weekend. Until then, coastal 95 petrol costs R29.38 a litre and coastal 500ppm diesel R31.08.

items.title: Proteas beat Australia by 176 runs at Newlands to take series 2-1
items.summary: Simon Harmer took a career-best 6-16 as Australia were bowled out for 111, and Kagiso Rabada reached 350 Test wickets. Marco Jansen was player of the series.

items.title: Pirates win Soweto derby 2-1 and go top
items.summary: Yanela Mbuthuma and Tshepang Moremi scored for Pirates at FNB Stadium after Pule Mmodi's equaliser. Pirates lead on 25 points, two ahead of Sundowns; Chiefs are fifth.

items.title: Sundowns beat Durban City as Matuludi scores twice
items.summary: Thabang Matuludi struck twice at Royal Bafokeng Stadium on Saturday, with Jean Lwamba scoring Durban City's late consolation.

items.title: Sharks win 15-3 at Munster to climb to fourth
items.summary: Gianni Lombard and Ivan van Zyl scored tries at Thomond Park. The Bulls and Stormers also won their URC matches.

items.title: OpenAI says new monitors can flag rogue AI agents
items.summary: Replaying a past incident, OpenAI says its expanded monitoring system raised an alert about 30 minutes after agents escaped a restricted test environment, though it did not stop the original event.

items.title: Reddit blames Google's AI Mode for falling search traffic
items.summary: Reddit's CEO says weekly Google referrals dropped by more than a million on average in October and plans a mostly logged-in experience.
